summary: 2026-08-03 08:30 PDT — The implementation satisfies the two amended behavior requirements, but its new drift coverage does not protect the required OPS-18 handoff. findings.title: OPS-18 handoff is not pinned
findings.claim: The new assertion only checks that the former retraction-review wording is absent. If the newly required parenthetical declaring retractions out of scope and assigning them to OPS-18 is deleted, this test still passes. That leaves AC5's required handoff unprotected and does not satisfy AC6's requirement to pin the load-bearing phrase at each edit site.
findings.suggestion: Add a positive `has` assertion for the new phase boundary and OPS-18 ownership wording, while retaining the `absent` assertion against reinstating the impossible duty.
